database.routers.query

SQL query execution endpoints

Provides direct SQL access to the database with safety measures

Attributes

router

ALLOWED_TABLES

Functions

execute_query(request, session)

Execute a SQL query against the database

list_tables(session[, include_samples])

List all available tables with metadata

get_table_schema(table_name, session)

Get detailed schema information for a specific table

validate_query(request)

Validate a SQL query without executing it

async database.routers.query.execute_query(request, session)[source]

Execute a SQL query against the database

Safety measures: - Read-only queries only (SELECT) - Limited result size - Query timeout

Parameters:

  • request (database.schemas.SQLQueryRequest)

  • session (database.dependencies.SessionDep)

Return type:

database.schemas.SQLQueryResponse

async database.routers.query.list_tables(session, include_samples=False)[source]

List all available tables with metadata

Returns information about each table including: - Table name - Record count - Column names - Indexes - Sample data (optional)

Parameters:

  • session (database.dependencies.SessionDep)

  • include_samples (bool)

Return type:

List[database.schemas.TableInfo]

async database.routers.query.get_table_schema(table_name, session)[source]

Get detailed schema information for a specific table

Returns: - Column definitions with types - Primary keys - Foreign keys - Indexes - Constraints

Parameters:

  • table_name (str)

  • session (database.dependencies.SessionDep)

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]

async database.routers.query.validate_query(request)[source]

Validate a SQL query without executing it

Checks for: - Syntax errors - Forbidden operations - Table existence

Parameters:

request (database.schemas.SQLQueryRequest)

Return type:

Dict[str, Any]
